title: About Us - SAI NET
text:
SAI NET

SAI NET Broadband is a innovative organization that has driven changes in this industry by taking the lead in providing affordable broadband access to home users and corporates, when it was thought to be impossible and still continues to do so. Today we provide with the one of the cheapest internet services in the city SAI NET Broadband is an ISP operating currently only in Mumbai and has established itself as one of the significant players in the City. SAI NET delivers its services via its Select entrepreneurs/cable operators who follow the standards set by the company. Over thousands of clients trust us with their business-critical needs.

#### Who We Are?

We are an advanced and accomplished technology company, dedicatedly working to deliver delight, benefit and achievement for people through, and by, a constant pursuit of excellence in Internet services.

#### Why Choose Us?

Years of experience enable us to understand the demand of customers and be able to reach their needs. It is the quality our service that dictates our survival in the market. We ought to stay in sync with the latest technology, which can be applied to deliver nothing but the best to our customers. Technical support and assistance is always made available to make sure you make the most out of our service and your need for entertainment is never compromised.

#### Our Vission

We crave for giving the ultimate in service. Be it simple home based Internet solutions or a highly reliable, secure leased line connectivity. We want to be your partners the most reliable, efficient, flexible and secure Our vision is to revolutionize broadband services in India by providing simple-to-understand yet state-of-the-art services that will enable people of our country to do so much more in their daily lives, thereby bringing them unprecedented advantage and joy, ultimately resulting in their success.
